metadata.title: 📱 app
metadata.description: 📱 Manage your Capgo app settings and configurations in Capgo Cloud.

blocks.text: 📱 Manage your Capgo app settings and configurations in Capgo Cloud.

➕ Add a new app to Capgo Cloud with a unique app ID in the format com.test.app.
All options can be guessed from config if not provided.
App name for display in Capgo Cloud
App icon path for display in Capgo Cloud
API key to link to your account
Custom Supabase host URL (for self-hosting or Capgo development)
🗑️ Delete an app from Capgo Cloud, optionally specifying a version to delete only that bundle.
API key to link to your account
Custom Supabase host URL (for self-hosting or Capgo development)
📋 List all apps registered under your account in Capgo Cloud.
API key to link to your account
Custom Supabase host URL (for self-hosting or Capgo development)

🐞 Listen for live update events in Capgo Cloud to debug your app.
Optionally target a specific device for detailed diagnostics.
API key to link to your account
The specific device ID to debug
Custom Supabase host URL (for self-hosting or Capgo development)

⚙️ Modify Capacitor configuration programmatically.
Specify setting path (e.g., plugins.CapacitorUpdater.defaultChannel) with --string or --bool.
A value for the setting to modify as a boolean, ex: --bool true
A value for the setting to modify as a string, ex: --string "Production"

⚙️ Update settings for an existing app in Capgo Cloud, such as name, icon, or retention period for bundles.
Retention of 0 means infinite storage.
App name for display in Capgo Cloud
Local image file path (png, jpg, webp, svg) used as the app icon in Capgo Cloud
API key to link to your account
Days to keep old bundles (0 = infinite, default: 0)
Expose bundle metadata (link and comment) to the plugin (true/false, default: false)
Enable bundle and channel preview QR codes for this app
Disable bundle and channel preview QR codes for this app
Allow devices to set a custom device ID for this app
Disallow custom device IDs for this app
Block provider infrastructure requests for this app
Allow provider infrastructure requests for this app
Native build timeout in minutes (5-360, default: 15)
iOS App Store URL for this app
Google Play Store URL for this app
Default upload channel name for this app
Default download channel name for this app (sets channel public=true)
Disable Capgo download channels for this app (sets all channels public=false)
Custom Supabase host URL (for self-hosting or Capgo development)
